# Welcome

This is a companion exercise book for [SPH5009](https://canvas.nus.edu.sg/courses/96080) at the NUS Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health.
Each numbered section corresponds to a week of the course. Contents are dynamically being built and adjusted as our course progresses to reflect the learnings in class.

## Setup before first day of class

Follow these [instructions](https://cerm-nus.github.io/r-intro/chapters/setup.html#r-first-then-rstudio)
for setting up R and Rstudio.
